plain: Set up or started, as a rule, a case or a group

webster.text: Established; appointed; founded; enacted; invested with the care of souls.

example.quote: The only security agst. encroachments will be a select & sagacious body of men, instituted to watch agst. them on all sides.
example.cite: James Madison, Notes of Debates in the Federal Convention of 1787, July 2, 1787
